description: Log a call record. Optional: outcome, notes, call_status_code, success (1/0), duration_sec, to_number, next_call_at (ISO). For an INCOMING call pass direction:'inbound' and from_number — and lead_id only if you know who it was. An unidentified incoming call is worth recording WITHOUT a lead: that is what makes find_by_phone's call_history answer 'this number has rung six times before', which is the difference between a persistent prospect and a call centre. Do not attach it to a lead you are only guessing at.

from_number.description: The calling number, for an inbound call. Any spelling — the search normalises it.

lead_id.description: Who it was. Omit for an incoming call from a number you could not identify.

outcome.description: Result of the call as free text

name: log_call
